description: Pipe flow pressure drop (Darcy-Weisbach) — Pipe friction loss and pressure drop. flow_gpm (or flow_lps/flow_m3h), inner diameter_in (or diameter_mm), length_ft (or length_m); optional material=pvc|copper|steel|galvanized|cast-iron|ductile-iron|stainless|hdpe|pex|concrete or roughness_mm, fluid=water|glycol-30|glycol-50|diesel|hydraulic-oil|seawater (or density_kgm3+viscosity_cp), temp_c, minor_k (fittings K sum), elevation_ft. Returns velocity, Reynolds number, regime, Colebrook friction factor, head loss, psi/kPa drop, hydraulic hp, Hazen-Williams cross-check, diameter for 5 ft/s and velocity warnings. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_pipe_flow
